name: @wevna/python
description: Turborepo shim for the Python SDK — delegates the four standard tasks to pytest, mypy and ruff.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/copy-dashboard-assets.mjs src/wevna/dashboard && bash scripts/run.sh python -c "import wevna; print('wevna', wevna.__version__)"
scripts.lint: bash scripts/run.sh ruff check . && bash scripts/run.sh ruff format --check .
